topic.title: Purpose-Built Student Accommodation / Nomination Agreements / Operations
topic.source_contract: student-need evidence, site and bedspace definition, higher-education nomination, affordable student accommodation, design, management, planning obligations, building-control and levy status, construction, occupation and operational performance evidence

scope_guards: A general housing need figure is not treated as PBSA need.
A university letter of interest is not treated as an executed nomination agreement.
A planning policy target is not treated as secured affordable student rent.
A management proposal is not treated as an appointed operator.
Planning permission is not treated as completed bedspaces.
Practical completion is not treated as occupied student accommodation.
Initial bookings are not treated as stabilised operational performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact consent, nomination, affordability, construction, occupation and operating evidence.
